_comment: Event fields: id (unique slug), title, description, image (path under assets/images/events/), dateStart (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-31T20:00:00), dateEnd (ISO 8601 - when the event ends, e.g. 2026-10-31T23:30:00). Set "events": [] to show the 'No events scheduled' message instead.
